messages:
Nora: Heads up — S3 bill for eval traces spiked this month. Full per-sample JSONL.gz retention at 90 days is killing us. Anyone have quick wins for lowering costs without losing debuggability? :eyes:
Miguel: Agree. Quick wins: store full traces only for failures + sampled subset for successes. Keep a tiny per-sample index (metadata) longer term instead of full payloads. Index entries are ~200B vs full 2KB so big savings.
Priya: Also seeing a runner bug that double-uploads when CI replays a job — that makes costs worse. We should make uploads idempotent at the runner layer. Patch idea below.
Priya: ```python
def upload_trace(trace_id, payload):
    key = f"{model}/{run_ts}/{trace_id}.jsonl.gz"
    idempotency_key = sha1(payload).hexdigest()
    if s3.object_exists(key, metadata={'idem': idempotency_key}):
        return
    s3.put_object(key, body=gzip(payload), metadata={'idem': idempotency_key})
```
Sam: Nice. Also add a local dedupe map in the runner for the job lifetime (trace_id -> upload_state) to handle immediate retries from CI. That avoids a roundtrip check on every retry.
Miguel: For the index schema I propose minimal fields: [trace_id, model, run_ts, sample_id, status, metrics_hash, size_bytes, compressed_size, storage_path]. Store as newline-delimited small JSON so we can query and join in dashboards.
Nora: Proposal for retention policy: full traces = 30d by default, keep a rolling 1% sample permanently (or 365d?), keep all failure traces 365d, and index retained 1yr. That should cut costs ~6x in our ballpark estimate. Thoughts? :thinking_face: 
Sam: No objections. One operational ask: have eval-bot emit artifact_size metrics per-run and add an alert if avg_compressed_size > 1KB/sample or if total > 5GB.
eval-bot: uploaded artifacts summary for run 2026-02-14 — samples=120000, avg_compressed_size=1.4KB, total=170MB (auto-posted).
Priya: I'll open a PR: idempotent uploads + sampling config + a unit test that reruns a job twice and asserts only one S3 object exists. Also add integration test for index record creation.
Nora: Perfect. Please also add notes to the eval-runner onboarding doc about the index format and retention defaults so teams onboarding new models don't opt into full retention by accident. I'll update the dashboard panel and run a quick cost model with finance next week. :+1:
